## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. VXX below trend (1W: -3.55% | 1M: -17.67%) falling and credit stress signal showing strain (Credit Spread 1W: +0.52% | 1M: +0.97%) provide opposing confirmations alongside SPY/TLT neutral (SPY in CORRECTION (1W: -1.04% | 1M: +0.54%), TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -1.14% | 1M: -1.62%)).

2. Primary Risk Drivers?  
Credit stress rising: HYG ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.04% | 1M: +0.54%) vs LQD BELOW TREND (1W: -0.44% | 1M: -0.29%) shows a split contributing to higher credit dispersion. Reflation and commodity strength: CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.28% | 1M: +8.84%) ↑ rising is supporting cyclicals while VXX falling signals lower acute fear.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?  
SPY/TLT in CORRECTION (SPY 1W: -1.04% | 1M: +0.54%; TLT 1W: -1.14% | 1M: -1.62%) points to mixed equities vs bonds dynamics. Dollar in RECOVERY (1W: +0.52% | 1M: -0.05%) and a slightly flatter yield curve keep financial conditions neutral-to-tight.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?  
Cyclicals concentrated: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.88% | 1M: +2.15%), ITA ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.82% | 1M: +10.28%), DBB ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.77% | 1M: +7.98%). Tech lagging with XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -1.37% | 1M: -0.09%) and XLF in CORRECTION (1W: -1.44% | 1M: +4.32%) — style mixed / no clear leadership given narrow breadth.

5. US vs Global?  
Emerging markets and China outperform: EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.34% | 1M: +5.05%) and FXI ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.29% | 1M: +1.93%) while US large caps SPY remain in CORRECTION (1W: -1.04% | 1M: +0.54%).

6. Speculative Appetite?  
Muted overall: IWM in CORRECTION (1W: -1.56% | 1M: +1.81%), ARKK in CORRECTION (1W: -2.90% | 1M: +0.12%), while IBIT is in RECOVERY (1W: +2.99% | 1M: -1.41%) — speculative flows selective rather than broad.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?  
Reflation/industrial metals leadership: CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.28% | 1M: +8.84%) and DBB ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.77% | 1M: +7.98%); gold in CORRECTION (GLD 1W: -3.31% | 1M: +2.85%) shows profit-taking amid commodity strength.

8. Energy Trend?  
Energy showing strength: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.88% | 1M: +2.15%) while Brent BNO BELOW TREND (1W: -1.60% | 1M: -2.01%) and natural gas UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -2.66% | 1M: -19.39%) remain weak — dispersion across energy complex.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?  
CONFIRMED: CPER, EEM, DBB both 1W and 1M positive indicating commodity/EM breadth where present. DIVERGENCE: major mismatch across core equities (SPY, IWM, XLF showing 1W vs 1M splits) — this MAJOR divergence suppresses strong directional regime calls and supports the NEUTRAL label.

10. Portfolio Direction?  
Favor cyclicals/commodity exposure showing strength (XLE, ITA, DBB) and EM exposure (EEM, FXI); reduce exposure to lagging tech and high-momentum names (XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -1.37% | 1M: -0.09%), ARKK CORRECTION (1W: -2.90% | 1M: +0.12%)) and monitor credit spreads and VXX for regime shifts.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?  
BULLISH: Energy XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.88% | 1M: +2.15%) and Industrials ITA ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.82% | 1M: +10.28%) if commodity strength holds. BEARISH: Tech XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -1.37% | 1M: -0.09%) and discretionary/financials if breadth fails to recover.

12. Commodities to Watch?  
BULLISH: Copper/CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.28% | 1M: +8.84%) and base metals DBB ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.77% | 1M: +7.98%). BEARISH: Natural gas UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -2.66% | 1M: -19.39%) and oil BNO BELOW TREND (1W: -1.60% | 1M: -2.01%).

13. Key Levels?  
VIX ~26 (VXX behavior; complacency vs risk), Credit Spread 0.7323 (1W: +0.52% | 1M: +0.97%) indicating stress, Tech/Financials ratio 2.6270 (1W: -0.28% | 1M: -3.17%) as style pivot to watch.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth is narrow at 4/11 sectors positive and mixed signals (VXX falling but credit stress rising) keep the market balanced. Commodities/EM and cyclicals are showing relative strength while tech/momentum exhibit notable divergence to monitor.
